guarantees.claim: For all y in 0..4, x in 0..4, z in 0..W-1, the function assigns bitarray[W*(5*y+x)+z] = state[x][y][z].

assumptions.claim: Parameter Width must be at least 25*W to avoid out-of-bounds writes; if Width > 25*W, higher bits of bitarray are unassigned.
assumptions.risk: Simulation error (out-of-range write) if Width < 25*W; X-propagation (unknown bits) if Width > 25*W and those bits are used later.

uncertain_points.claim: The function requires Width >= 25*W; if keccak_2share is instantiated with Width != 25*W, the linearization breaks.
uncertain_points.risk: Silent data corruption, out-of-bounds access, or X values on unused bits.
